C002.reason: This line creates a v1 Entity instance with Name property being set. Must be removed as Name field is being removed from v1 schema construction.

rationale: The schema change removes the 'name' field from Entity message in v1 by reserving field number 2 and name 'name'. The C# runtime must be updated to: (1) remove Name from the fields dictionary in ProcessEntity for v1, (2) remove Name initialization when constructing v1 Entity instances. The v2 behavior remains unchanged as per intended_behavior. EntityId is preserved and legacy payloads with field 2 will decode correctly since the field number is reserved (not deleted).
assumptions: Generated protobuf bindings have been regenerated by the host using buf generate
